Geometric transport assembles the actual open counit and closed unit square. Exactness plus the first two invertible sequence components proves invertibility of the actual third component. Scalar transport proves the native restriction comparisons are actual mates and uses the same counit/unit maps.

The normalized third arrow is e₃⁻¹ ≫ mapped(δ) ≫ shift(e₁); first and third vertex isomorphisms use actual inverse open/proper normalizations followed by the actual compositor. No torsion-subcategory triangulation or t-structure is assumed.
